performance_tasks.brief: proofreading task: an original paragraph of about 120 words with a stated number of errors of named kinds (comma splices and capitals), written into the prompt; the corrected paragraph is the answer
proofreading task: an original paragraph of about 120 words with a stated number of errors of named kinds (tense and agreement), written into the prompt; the corrected paragraph is the answer

proofreading task: an original paragraph of about 120 words with a stated number of errors of named kinds (speech punctuation and paragraphing), written into the prompt; the corrected paragraph is the answer

rewriting task: an original flat or overlong paragraph of about 100 words (a descriptive paragraph), written into the prompt, to be rewritten with precise vocabulary and controlled, varied sentences; a model rewrite is the answer

rewriting task: an original flat or overlong paragraph of about 100 words (an argument paragraph), written into the prompt, to be rewritten with precise vocabulary and controlled, varied sentences; a model rewrite is the answer

ao_mix_note: Marks-equivalent counts the performance tasks at the AO split of the level table each models. Flashcards model no paper item and carry no tariff, so they count nothing here; they carry their objective’s AOs.
